title: Simulate bulk electron drift velocity
description: Contains the drift velocity curve that is compared to the expected physical result for GaAs.
output_schema: Columns: electric_field_kV_cm (float), drift_velocity_cm_s (float). Rows for each simulated field point covering at least [0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25, 30] kV/cm.

title: Simulate n⁺nn⁺ device current‑voltage characteristics
description: Contains the I‑V curve that is compared to the expected physical result for the n⁺nn⁺ structure.
output_schema: Columns: bias_voltage_V (float), current_density_A_cm2 (float). Rows for each simulated bias point covering at least [0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, 2.0, 2.2, 2.5] V.
